description: Use this when the caller needs to discover and rank live x402 providers for a task before choosing downstream spend. KlearFlow does not execute the selected provider. Routing costs $0.005 via x402 Base USDC.

excludeHosts.description: Optional provider hostnames to exclude from the ranked result, useful to avoid self-routing or previously rejected providers.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked provider candidates to return.

maxPriceUsd.description: Optional maximum listed provider price in USD.

preferPaidVerified.description: When true, rank providers with independent paid-verification evidence higher.

task.description: Plain-English capability the caller wants a live x402 provider to perform.

name: route_task

network.description: Payment network identifier, currently Base mainnet eip155:8453.

payer.description: Settled payer address when supplied by the payment facilitator.

priceUsd.description: USDC-denominated execution price settled through x402.

proofId.description: Unique KlearFlow proof identifier for this settled paid execution.

result.description: Routing result containing the ranked live x402 provider candidates and the selected recommendation; no downstream provider is executed.

title: Route Task
